Added `specs/mapreduce-pipeline-topology/`, the design work for arbitrary-topology pipelines in `mngr-mapreduce`.

`library-survey.md` investigates whether the pipeline layer should be built on an existing open-source workflow orchestrator (Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, Metaflow, Flyte, Kedro, ZenML, Beam, Covalent, Luigi, Hamilton, Temporal, DBOS) instead of in-house. The recommendation is to build the model and take only the DAG core from `graphlib` in the standard library: the scheduling a library would replace is about thirty lines, the agent lifecycle it would not replace is about three hundred and forty, and the cheapest candidate would add twelve packages to a wheel end users install. The survey records each candidate's measured transitive dependency count against `imbue-mngr`'s own 67 packages.

`requirements.md` is the contract the design must satisfy, stated separately from any design that meets it: what the model must be able to express (`M`), how an execution must behave (`E`), the external constraints (`C`), and what is deliberately out of scope (`N`). Requirements that encode a policy choice rather than a fact are marked as such, and open questions are listed at the end.

`arbitrary_topology_pipelines.md` specifies the replacement of the linear `Stage`/`Step` model with a directed acyclic graph of `Node`s scheduled by `graphlib.TopologicalSorter`. A node declares the artifacts it `needs` rather than a single `base`, which separates what a node waits for from the git ref its agent checks out; fan-out becomes a typed `FanoutKind` (`SINGLE`, `PER_UPSTREAM_JOB`, `PER_PARTITION`, `DISCOVERED`) so the framework performs the graph arithmetic instead of each plugin; and prompts move into the pipeline, with each node carrying the Jinja template its jobs render from.

Who performs a node is the node's work rather than a flag beside it: `Node.work` is a discriminated union of `AgentWork` and `OrchestratorWork`, so an orchestrator node has no prompt, fan-out, gate or completion threshold to set wrongly, and an agent node cannot carry an empty template. A node that falls short of its `required_completion` fraction halts the whole run rather than just its own descendants, so `stopped_reason` records the single point at which an execution stopped. Resumability, retries and the existing `MapReduceRecipe` path are explicit non-goals.
